text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, did you see Yaeno Muteki?! Her

acceleration was amazing!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! She was astounding! I bet she's
gonna steal
the show at the Classics next
year!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...So this is the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki's expression is tight with

exhaustion as she returns to the waiting
room.
choice_data_list_en: ...Yaeno? Are you all right?
...Yaeno? Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She didn't seem particularly out of
breath when
she crossed the finish line,
so what could've
caused this?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I'm... ashamed of myself. I got swept up
by the
excitement on the track.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The feverish energy from the stands
affected me
a great deal...
choice_data_list_en: Did the atmosphere get to you?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
As a result, I had to expend far more
energy than
usual to keep my inner
flame at bay.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems the heated atmosphere fanned
her
competitive spirit and made it
difficult to control,
thus causing a
greater strain on her mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Right now, it's best to prioritize her
recovery. I
tell her to take it easy and
that we'll have a
meeting in place of
training tomorrow.
choice_data_list: 今日は帰ってゆっくり休んで
choice_data_list_en: Go home and get some good rest today.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Understood. My apologies for my lack of
control.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next morning, I take a stroll out to
the
riverside, wondering the whole way
over if Yaeno
Muteki has recovered yet.
Huff... Huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While I'm partially surprised to see her, I
also had
a feeling she might be here.
After all, I know just
how disciplined and
harsh she is on herself.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Oh! Good morning, Trainer.
choice_data_list_en: Yaeno!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine. The burden on my mind has
lifted as well.
My thoughts are clear
once more.
choice_data_list_en: Are you feeling alright?
Are you feeling alright?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Allow me to demonstrate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't look like there's anything to
worry
about her physically, judging from
how easily
she's doing her squats, but...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can sense some impatience from her,
just from
the mere fact that she's doing
regular exercises
and not practicing her
katas.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
choice_data_list_en: Are you feeling anxious about something?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Nothing gets past you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
My debut race yesterday... made me
painfully
aware of my own ineptitude.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
My mental fortitude is still lacking if it
can be so
easily swayed by something
like the crowd's
enthusiasm.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I'm satisfied with my performance during
the race.
Thinking ahead, however...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I'm afraid I won't be able to fight on with
how
easily I stray from the path of blaze
fierce, water
still.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I must train both my mind and body even
further!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
No. This is a matter that concerns only
me. I
couldn't possibly bother you—
choice_data_list: それなら、相談してくれればいいのに
choice_data_list_en: If that's the case, I wish you'd talked to me about it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her that handling her intense
competitive
drive is a given, as I'm
already well aware of it,
and that I'm
prepared to discuss and create a plan
to
help train her mental strength.
choice_data_list: 手間だなんて思わない
choice_data_list_en: I don't consider it a hassle at all.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Have you lost your wits?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...My apologies. Nobody has ever said
such a
thing to me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I was young, teachers and
other adults
alike gave up on me
because they were so
appalled by my
unruly behavior.

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno
text_block_list.text:
I put up with it like you told me to! I
held it in
even when I was mad! But they
wouldn't stop
bugging me!

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno
text_block_list.text:
So I got angrier and angrier, and my
head got all
hot and—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, you did hold your feelings in.
Next time,
try to hold them in a little
longer. Doing so will
strengthen your
patience.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: For that, you must train. Come, Yaeno.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Despite my repeated failures, my
grandfather
accepted me for who I was.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
And whenever I felt dejected, my
grandmother
would hold me close and
cheer me on.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Though I have to say, I must have been a
real
handful.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Why would you go so far for me?
choice_data_list: 俺も君と向き合っていきたいと思っている
私も貴方と向き合っていきたいと思っている
choice_data_list_en: I want to face things head-on with you, too.
I want to face things together with you too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I bear the weight of supporting Yaeno
Muteki
through three of the most
important years in her
life. I tell her I'll
never be content with merely
guiding
her to victory.
choice_data_list: 君のトレーナーだから
貴方のトレーナーだから
choice_data_list_en: Because I'm your Trainer.
Because I'm your Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It seems that I was the one who had

underestimated your duties as a trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
You seem ready to go through any
lengths for my
sake.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Then... would you be willing to bear the
weight of
my contrary nature, alongside
everything else?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...There's not a hint of hesitation in your
eyes.
Your words are not born simply
from a sense of
responsibility, but from
the heart.
choice_data_list_en: That's the plan.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I shall put my faith in you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to renew my commitment to
working
with you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I shall do my very best not to squander
your good
will.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I don't wish to impose the same burden
on you
that I did on my grandparents.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Very much so. The whole reason I want
to do well
in the Twinkle Series is so I
can show them how
much I've grown.
choice_data_list: おじいさんたちに深く感謝しているんだな
おじいさんたちに深く感謝しているんだね
choice_data_list_en: You're really grateful to those old gentlemen, aren't you?
You're really grateful to those old gentlemen, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It's not so much a repayment for their
kindness,
but... it's more like an
expression of my gratitude
for
everything they've done for me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
And to prove my growth, I must defeat
mighty
opponents while keeping my
competitive
impulses at bay.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I hope to face many a great adversary in
the
Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I wish to take on the Classic Triple
Crown
tour.
choice_data_list_en: So, our next goal is...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It is the tried-and-true path to
greatness, so
there's bound to be
incredible contenders. I wish
to train my
mind and body through battle with

them.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
But there is something I'm concerned
about...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I'm unsure if I'll be able to maintain my
form due
to my inexperience with the
Triple Crown races...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's right to be worried. The audience's
energy
at her debut race was nothing
like that of the
Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In order for her to become acclimated to
that
energy and successfully maintain
her form, she'll
need to develop her race
instincts...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain that the skill level of those
competing at
the Mainichi Hai will make
it a perfect prep race
for the Classic
Triple Crown.
choice_data_list_en: Want to enter the Mainichi Hai?
Why not enter the Mainichi Hai?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Joining that race would still allow
us
ample time to deal with any issues
which might
arise... Very well. I have no
objections.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Let's take on the Mainichi Hai.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Now that I have a goal to work
toward, I'm
keener than ever to train!
